_note: Real instruments with real purposes. Comedy comes from using them in absurd situations.

name: Gas Analyzer
description: Identifies atmospheric composition. Some survey and analysis choices need one.
passive_flavor: The gas analyzer hums quietly near the viewport. It knows things you don't.
gameplay_effect: Unlocks extra survey and analysis choices in some planet, nebula, anomaly and derelict events.

name: Repair Kit
description: General repair supplies. Consumed on use.
gameplay_effect: Contributes 20 effort to mechanical repairs. Consumed on use.

name: Water Purifier
description: Converts planet water to usable water resource. Also reduces crop water consumption.
passive_flavor: The water purifier whirs on approach to a planet. It has opinions about the water.
gameplay_effect: On planet nodes: converts local water to ship water supply. Passively: crop water consumption reduced 10%.

name: Geiger Counter
description: Detects radiation. Clicks ominously near bad decisions.
passive_flavor: The Geiger counter clicks. It does that sometimes. It does that more near derelicts.
gameplay_effect: Warns before radiation hazard events. Without it, crew takes damage before you know why.

name: Soil Sampler
description: Determines planet crop viability. Affects ending score.
passive_flavor: The soil sampler is ready. It has been ready the entire trip. It was designed for this.
gameplay_effect: Using on planet nodes reveals soil quality data — affects ending score. Contributes to crop event effort.

name: Portable Drill
description: Subsurface extraction. Rich asteroids turn up twice as often.
gameplay_effect: Asteroid mining minigame: rich asteroids turn up twice as often.

name: Spectrometer
description: Material analysis. Reads what unknown cargo really is, and appraises trade goods to the gold (inventory detail and sell offers).
passive_flavor: The spectrometer has identified the substance. You may not want to know.
gameplay_effect: While aboard, it appraises your cargo: the inventory shows what unknown items really are, and the exact value of every trade good whose worth varies from piece to piece, in the hold and on station and fence sell offers. Without it, you see only the range. Some events offer spectrometer-only choices.
design_note: Analyses classified cargo, unidentified bone, alien seed pod; exact value for the sell_range curios (pre-collapse artifact, corporate memorabilia, unidentified bone, mystery provisions). Unlocks requires_item spectrometer choices.

name: Medical Scanner
description: Crew diagnostics. Reads the odds in a wound crisis before you choose, and helps wounds heal faster.
gameplay_effect: Previews outcomes in wound crises. Wounded crew heal +2 HP more per leg.

name: Pressure Suit (EVA)
description: Required for vacuum operations. Some boarding and EVA choices stay locked without one.
gameplay_effect: Unlocks suited choices in some derelict, nebula and void events: boarding, EVA, hull work.
design_note: Gate item.

name: Solar Array (Portable)
description: Passive fuel trickle near stars. Useless in void.
passive_flavor: The solar array unfolds near a star. It drinks light. The power gauge twitches upward.
gameplay_effect: Passive fuel +2 per leg when near a star. No effect in void or deep space.

name: Emergency Beacon
description: Distress signal. One use. Rescue not guaranteed friendly.
gameplay_effect: If the fuel runs out, the beacon becomes your last option: someone will answer. They may be friendly, hostile, or corporate.
design_note: A choice on the no_fuel failure screen (endings.js endTriggerBeacon); the rescue roll is friendly / corporate / hostile.

_section: SHIP UPGRADES — purchasable at stations, active while in cargo

name: Expanded Fuel Tank
description: Fuel max +20. Installed passive — no cargo cost.
gameplay_effect: Fuel max increased from 100 to 120. Active while in cargo.

name: Hull Plating
description: Hull max +15. The ship groans slightly differently now.
gameplay_effect: Hull max increased from 100 to 115. Active while in cargo.

name: Insulated Cargo Bay
description: Food depletes slower. Also helps regulate growbay temperature.
gameplay_effect: Food consumption reduced 15%. Crop temperature-related damage reduced 20%. Cargo max +5.

name: Atmospheric Condenser
description: Pulls water out of nebula gas, one patient droplet at a time. Unlocks CONDENSE in nebulae.
gameplay_effect: Unlocks the CONDENSE verb in nebulae: a day of work for +12 water. Active while in cargo.

name: Shield Module
description: A bolt-on shield emitter. In a fight, BOOST SHIELDS blocks the next hit completely. Once per fight.
gameplay_effect: Enables BOOST SHIELDS in combat: the next incoming enemy hit is fully blocked. Once per combat. Not consumed.

_section: LOOT-ONLY ITEMS — never in shops, found via salvage/events/minigames

name: Experimental Drive Coil
description: Fuel burn reduced. Occasional misfire. The warranty expired before it was installed.
passive_flavor: The drive coil hums. Sometimes it hums differently. You try not to think about it.
gameplay_effect: Fuel burn reduced 20%. 5% chance per leg of a misfire event (minor hull damage).

name: Prototype O2 Recycler
description: O2 depletes slower. Warranty void. The warranty was void when you found it.
gameplay_effect: O2 consumption halved (the crew breathe it slower) and O2 losses from events reduced 25%. Occasionally makes concerning sounds.

name: Field Repair Fabricator
description: Upgrades the onboard fabricator. Unlocks the Fuel Cell and O2 Canister recipes and cuts wear 10%.
gameplay_effect: Unlocks additional fabricator recipes. Reduces fabricator wear by 10%.

name: Classified Cargo
description: Unknown until spectrometer is used. May attract attention. Contents may be valuable, dangerous, or both.
passive_flavor: The classified cargo sits in the hold. It hasn't done anything. You check on it anyway.
gameplay_effect: Unknown effects until a spectrometer identifies it. May draw a station inspection.
design_note: Contents randomized from a pool.
analysis: Through the seal: organic, kept cold, and shielded against exactly this kind of scan. The readout gives up and recommends delivering it on time.

_section: EVENT REWARD ITEMS — granted by specific events

analysis: Dormant, not dead. Alien, and built like a key rather than a snack — something out in the deep void will want it back.
name: Unidentified Seed Pod
description: Biological. Alien. Unknown. The xenobiologist is very excited. This is concerning.
passive_flavor: The seed pod pulses faintly. It is warm. It should not be warm.
gameplay_effect: Opens a diplomatic option at a deep-space anomaly, if a xenobiologist is aboard. Collectors and station labs pay for it; a fence pays best.
design_note: Key for the diplomatic gate at a deep-space anomaly (requires xenobiologist).

analysis: Edible, technically. Cultured, definitely. Left near the chef it becomes cheese; left alone it becomes a story.
name: Suspicious Fungus
description: Found growing somewhere it shouldn't. Anyone who cooks has been looking at it in a way that concerns everyone else.
passive_flavor: The fungus is growing. Slowly. Someone checks on it daily. Someone else checks on them.
gameplay_effect: With a chef in the crew, it may turn into something remarkable. Some alien vendors will trade for it.
design_note: Key for event_shipboard_016, the Chef's Secret Project (requires_role chef: a chef aboard as crew). Produces artisanal_space_cheese. Found on a good FORAGE on alien, habitable or anomalous ground: find_odds.forage is the chance (cruise.js).

name: Fabricator Surplus
description: The fabricator produced this instead of what you asked for. It is almost, but not quite, entirely unlike the thing you needed.
passive_flavor: The surplus object sits in the hold. Nobody can identify what it was supposed to be.
gameplay_effect: Leftovers from fabricator misfires. The Surplus Collector at outposts pays above market value for these.
design_note: Junk item from 15% of fabricator misfires. Accumulates. Mystery is the feature.

_section: CONSUMABLES — one-use restoratives, loot or purchase, stackable

name: Ration Brick
description: Compressed nutrition. Flavorless. Keeps people alive long enough to complain about it.
gameplay_effect: Restores +10 FOOD on use.
design_note: Stackable (0.2 slot per unit).

name: Water Canister
description: Sealed potable water. Heavier than it looks. Tastes exactly how you'd expect.
gameplay_effect: Restores +10 H2O on use.
design_note: Stackable (0.3 slot per unit).

name: Fuel Cell
description: Portable fuel packet. Rated for field use. Rating is optimistic.
gameplay_effect: Restores +15 FUEL on use.
design_note: Stackable (0.3 slot per unit).

name: Medkit
description: Sealed trauma kit. Mostly bandages, mostly-working injectors, mostly the right drugs.
gameplay_effect: Heals someone aboard who is injured. Turns 15% of would-be-lethal outcomes into injuries instead.
design_note: Stackable (0.1 slot per unit).

name: Hull Patch
description: Adhesive-backed alloy plate. The instructions are printed on the sticky side.
gameplay_effect: Restores +15 HULL when used in a hull crisis.
design_note: Craftable at the fabricator (recipe_hull_patch). Stackable (2 slots per 10).

_section: CURIOSITIES — trade goods, no mechanical effect, unique instance prices rolled at pickup

name: Pre-Collapse Artifact
description: Relic from before everything went sideways. Appraisers disagree about which sideways.
gameplay_effect: Worth 15-45g; each piece has its own value. A station trader pays exactly that; a fence pays half again as much. Without a spectrometer aboard, the hold and sell offers show only the range.
design_note: Pure trade good. Value rolled at pickup (sell_range, STATE.itemValues). Found on a good SALVAGE haul: find_odds.salvage is its own roll (cruise.js).

analysis: Not food. Machine parts in grease paper, and one item with a sense of occasion. Opening it pays in parts; selling it sealed pays in gold.
name: Mystery Provisions
description: A crate of unlabeled cans. The manifest says 'assorted.' The manifest is not wrong.
passive_flavor: The crate of unlabeled cans sits in cargo, assorted at everyone.
gameplay_effect: Worth 8-20g; each crate has its own value. A station trader pays exactly that; a fence pays half again as much. Without a spectrometer aboard, the hold and sell offers show only the range.
design_note: Pure trade good. Value rolled at pickup (sell_range, STATE.itemValues). Granted by event_crisis_006 when the cans are saved for trade, or bought sealed from the travelling trader (event_encounter_trader_001); event_general_009 opens it or sells it sealed for a flat 22g.

name: Sealed Vinyl Record
description: Analog music storage, still in shrinkwrap. Collectors are very serious about the shrinkwrap.
gameplay_effect: Fixed value: a station trader pays 17g (two-thirds of its 25g price), a fence pays the full 25g.
design_note: Pure trade good.

name: Corporate Memorabilia
description: A logo-stamped object from a company that no longer exists. The logo is the whole point.
gameplay_effect: Worth 5-15g; each piece has its own value. A station trader pays exactly that; a fence pays half again as much. Without a spectrometer aboard, the hold and sell offers show only the range.
design_note: Pure trade good. Value rolled at pickup (sell_range, STATE.itemValues). Found on a good SALVAGE haul: find_odds.salvage is its own roll (cruise.js).

name: Unidentified Bone
description: Bone. Species unknown. Size: inconvenient.
gameplay_effect: Worth 4-28g; each piece has its own value. A station trader pays exactly that; a fence pays half again as much. Without a spectrometer aboard, the hold and sell offers show only the range.
design_note: Pure trade good. Value rolled at pickup (sell_range, STATE.itemValues). Found on a good SALVAGE haul: find_odds.salvage is its own roll (cruise.js).
analysis: Not bone. A mineral cast of something that grew in low gravity, very slowly. Collectors pay for the story; a fence pays better than a station.

_section: STORY ITEMS — info-only, advance events or reveal options

name: Logbook Fragment
description: Pages from someone else's run. Handwriting deteriorates in the last third.
gameplay_effect: Unlocks extra options in events tied to the ship's previous crew.
design_note: Info-only.

name: Star Chart Fragment
description: Partial nav data from an older run. USE it to scout the next stop on the route.
gameplay_effect: Use it from the inventory: locks in and reports the event at the next stop (like a good SCAN). Consumed on use.

name: Distress Beacon Tag
description: ID tag from a responded-to distress call. Someone's family will want this.
gameplay_effect: A station authority further along may ask for it, and pass it on to the family. No sell value.
design_note: Triggers a station follow-up event when docked; resolves a narrative thread.

name: Crop Treatment
description: Nutrient solution for sick crops. The botanist approves. The fabricator is indifferent.
gameplay_effect: Use it from the inventory or in a sick-crop crisis: crop health +30 and any pest outbreak cleared.
design_note: Fabricated (2 biocomponent + 1 minerals). Stackable (2 slots per 10).

name: O2 Canister
description: Compressed oxygen, fabricated. The process is louder than it needs to be.
gameplay_effect: Opened in a low-O2 crisis: O2 +14.
design_note: Fabricated (3 minerals + 2 metal; needs the Repair Fabricator upgrade). Stackable (3 slots per 10).
